Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly framed the task as involving an “Australia–New Zealand 2022 World Cup bid” (there was no joint AU–NZ bid for the 2022 men’s World Cup), which misdirected the search plan from the outset. This confusion was later compounded at step 3 by the false claim that Ben Buckley’s birthdate matches October 22, 1930, but the first mistake occurred at step 1.
